Description: (a) Debts are in due and assessed as fully and timely recoverable for both principals and interests; or(b) Debts are overdue for a period of less than 10 days and assessed as fully recoverable for both overdue principals and interests, and fully and timely recoverable for both remaining principals and interests.
(a) Debts are overdue for a period of between 10 days and 90 days; or(b) Debts of which the repayment terms are restructured for the first time.
